title: Error boundaries and Suspense: Provide a localized error fallback and a separate loading fallback without treating both conditions as the same failure
description: A practical React 19 lesson for error boundaries and suspense, with an intentionally failing starter, complete TypeScript instructor implementation, local assertions and honest runtime scope.
objectives: Provide a localized error fallback and a separate loading fallback without treating both conditions as the same failure.
Repair the broken behavior in the react-error-suspense starter.
Demonstrate correct and edge-case outcomes using offline tests.
rubric: I can articulate the React 19 contract for error boundaries and suspense.
I can reproduce, repair and test the 06.04.07 starter case.
I can explain the difference between a local fixture and production persistence or browser behavior.

sources.label: React official: Error boundaries and Suspense
